takeaway: Alpha motor neurons sit in lamina IX of the spinal cord grey matter and innervate extrafusal muscle fibres.

question.text: The spinal cord grey matter has 10 laminae on each side. Which lamina contains the alpha motor neurons?

lines.text: The spinal cord grey matter is stacked in ten laminae.
Laminae one to six form the dorsal horn, so the upper steps are out.
Laminae seven to nine sit in the ventral horn.
Alpha motor neurons are big, strong cells, standing on lamina nine.
Lamina ten only borders the central canal.
Their axons supply extrafusal muscle fibres.
So the answer is lamina nine.
